_note: v0 seed content. Written from the ticket data (which issues bounce back, and why) plus assumptions about the RideOps product. Engineering (Sandeep's team) should own and correct this file; every 'returned to L1' outcome is a candidate for a new line here.

config_checks: Client booking cut-off in Admin > Settings matches what the admin expects (cut-off changes apply from the next roster cycle, not the current one)
Shift timing exists and is active for the site and date in question
Affected employees are active, mapped to the right site/shift, and have no pending approval
Roster was regenerated after the change (manual re-run if the change was made after cut-off)
For Excel uploads: the upload error report was checked (rejected rows are usually bad employee IDs or date formats)
required_info: Affected employee IDs (or the upload file)
Booking IDs (for ad-hoc or cancelled bookings)
When the change was made, and by whom
Screenshot of what the admin sees

config_checks: Driver app is on the current version
Driver phone has location permission set to 'Always' and battery saver off
Trip was actually started in the driver app (tracking only runs on started trips)
Tracking link is for today's trip and was shared with the right recipients (links expire after trip end)
Check for a network or blackspot issue on that route (several cabs in the same area affected)
required_info: Time window when location was wrong (IST)

config_checks: Check the known-issues list first (report exports have the most 'duplicate of known issue' escalations)
Date range is within the supported limit; retry with a shorter range
User's role has permission for this report
For scheduled emails: recipient address is correct and the mail is not in spam or quarantine
Filters are not excluding the 'missing' trips (cancelled or no-show trips are filtered by default)
required_info: For missing trips: 2-3 example trip IDs

config_checks: Employee's registered mobile number is correct
SMS is not blocked (DND, or carrier delay) and the OTP was not regenerated in between
Driver started the trip before the employee entered the OTP
Driver app is on the current version
Rate card and its effective date are mapped to the right vendor
Dead-km and cancellation charges follow the client contract (often contractual, not a bug)
Toll configuration for the route was checked
The trip count was compared using the same filters and billing period as the invoice
Address was updated in the employee profile AND the map pin was moved (text alone does not re-geocode)
Routing picks up changes from the next roster cycle; was the cycle re-run?
For new societies: pin placed manually on the gate location
required_info: Date the change should apply from

config_checks: User exists and has the correct role (most 'access to module' requests are role changes L1 can make)
For SSO: client's IdP mapping and user's email domain match
For lock-outs: lock-out timer has expired; unlock from Admin

How-to / feature request.owner: Not engineering: L1 answers how-tos; feature requests go to Product
config_checks: Search the help centre / macro library for the how-to
If it is a feature request, log it with Product and close the ticket with the client informed
required_info: What the client is trying to achieve

config_checks: This is usually operational: route to the transport ops desk or vendor
Escalate to engineering only if GPS or trip logs show a system fault (e.g. driver marked no-show without reaching the pickup)
required_info: GPS trail evidence (if claiming a system fault)

config_checks: Route to the compliance team to block the vehicle; engineering only if blocking failed in the system
